fields.title: 7. Three data points to verify directly before the next issue (monthly 2026-11, 11/01)
fields.md:
1. **Original text of 10-Q Item 1A risk factors** — Whether the phrases "the government may require service restrictions," "geopolitics," and "Starshield control" appear, and how they are worded. How far the company had disclosed before this event is the background for the E-2027-4 and A-2030-1 determinations ([10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066880/spcx-20260930.htm)).
2. **Official record of foreign government reactions** — Whether the EU, Germany, the UK, Poland and others have made **official** announcements reviewing their reliance on Starlink (parliamentary resolutions, procurement notices, contract terminations). Only official documents are counted, not media reports or statements (input to the deliberation on proposed new rule ④).
3. **Keep the T5·T4 check items** — EDGAR 8-K Item 1.01 (GPU lease signing, fixed interest rate), Amazon Leo Vulcan LV-01 November schedule and pricing posted ([EDGAR 8-K list](https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001181412&type=8-K&dateb=&owner=include&count=10)).
